name: inkast
description: Local-first AI image studio. Prose to structured JSON prompt to image. ClaudeCode-native.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @inkast/shared build && pnpm --filter @inkast/web build && pnpm --filter @inkast/api build
scripts.public:build: pnpm --filter @inkast/shared build && pnpm --filter @inkast/web-public build && pnpm --filter @inkast/api-public build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @inkast/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @inkast/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @inkast/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @inkast/web-public typecheck && pnpm --filter @inkast/api-public typecheck
